Program.description: An exact declaration of the Work and organizational meaning executed together.

ExecutionRequest.description: An occurrence requesting execution of one declared Program.

Activation.description: An occurrence in which declared Work becomes enabled.
Activation.derivation: The identity of the originating ExecutionRequest.

Completion.description: An occurrence in which activated Work completes.

Execution.description: The immutable proof of a Program's execution state.

execution.law: Each concrete Activation refinement declares its exact Work and prerequisite fields.
A multiple-prerequisite Activation composes one frozen product whose required fields are the complete prerequisite set.
Each concrete Completion refinement declares its exact Activation and outcome fields.
An ExecutionRequest constructs its initial Activation; each Completion constructs the successor execution fact and its emission.
A transport carries ExecutionRequests, Activations, and Completions but owns none of their execution semantics.
A terminal Completion recursively preserves its originating request, exact Activations, exact Completions, and outcomes.
